summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on 18 September 2026 announcing daily purchases of its ordinary shares under two existing buyback programmes announced 30 January 2026 and 31 July 2026. On 14-18 September 2026 the company bought shares via broker Goldman Sachs International at volume-weighted average prices of roughly 109.2-111.3 pence, with per-share highs up to 112.0 pence and lows of 108.0 pence; purchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Watch execution pace, remaining programme capacity and any change to buyback authorization.
